notes: Four decks on their own MIDI channels: the controller switches them itself (DECK buttons; deck focus follows). SHIFT (any) is modifier 1; most shifted buttons also send other notes. Pad modes are modifiers 2-5 (decks 1-4: 0 Hot Cue, 1 Auto Loop, 2 Fader Cuts, 3 Sampler 1-8 on deck C's cells, 4 Hot Cue 9-16, which the app does not have, 5 Sampler 9-16 on deck D's). SCRATCH toggles turntable / jog mode per deck (modifiers 6-9). The DECK buttons also set which deck is active on each side (modifiers 10 and 11). Jogs: 1024 counts per turn; SHIFT + jog searches. SHIFT + PFL: slip. FX: each paddle (up or down) assigns its side's active deck to both units, middle unassigns; the three effect buttons of each unit toggle its slots (Mixxx makes them exclusive and turns the chosen ones on only with the paddle); the FX encoder moves the three knobs of both units; both FX knobs are dry/wet of both units. Not mapped: long / double press pad modes (Beat Jump, Key Play, Cue Loop), loop rolls, SHIFT + play (beatgrid), SHIFT + CUE (start and stop), TAP (Mixxx picks a deck by its own rules), SHIFT + LOAD (eject), SHIFT + headphone level (samplers' gain), browse push, jog screens (BPM, time, rate), VU meters, LED blinking. Not mapped from the Mixxx file: [Library] ScrollVertical. Translated from the Mixxx mapping by Evoixmr (Mixxx 2.4 version), from QGazQ's tweaks of Octopussy's mapping, based on the mapping by h67ma, bad1dea5, photoenix, Matthew Nicholson, Ending and Kaj Bostrom, GPL-2.0-or-later (crates/control/profiles/MIXXX-NOTICE.md).
